anchors.role: World/frame update dispatcher; bounded control flow verified
observations: 384 original dispatcher call-order cases and 9600 own-state assertions match; all direct subsystem callees are explicit no-op adapters.
The original takes a world pointer AND a separate output/state pointer; Ghidra conflates the second parameter.
Pause/force/override/cutscene/audio/level-flag branches have synthetic native fixtures. Positive timers subtract delta without clamping at zero.
No complete world-frame, live subsystem, menu, populated player or level-transition equivalence is claimed.
9024 additional player/menu/transition/native-state cases and 42176 assertions pass; see native-frame-branches.json. Only the two transition state helpers execute as original subsystem callees there.
